description:
Colibird turns requests that span several of your apps into one conversation. It runs on your own Mac or Windows PC and connects ChatGPT to your mail, calendar, contacts, reminders, notes, files, PDFs, and Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

What it adds beyond a single connector:
• Multi-step workflows across apps — read a customer's email, build the Excel quote, write the Word brief and set the reminder, in one request.
• Recipes — save a workflow and run it again later with one prompt.
• Daily brief — today's meetings, unread mail and pending reminders in one summary.
• Local-first — tools run on your computer with the accounts already set up in your apps (no API keys), and your mailbox and files are not copied to the cloud.
• You stay in control — you approve the connection on your computer, admins can disable tools by policy, and sending or deleting requires explicit confirmation.

defaultPrompt: Give me my daily brief: today's meetings, unread email and pending reminders
Find the vendor invoices forwarded to my inbox and build an Excel sheet in my Documents folder
Read the latest email from a customer, write the talking points in a Word doc and remind me tomorrow

name: lmcp-app

positive.description: Daily brief across calendar, mail and reminders
positive.prompt: Give me my daily brief: today's meetings, unread email and pending reminders.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one summary of the demo account's meetings for today, its unread emails and its pending reminders, using only data from the connected demo computer.

positive.prompt: Add a 30-minute meeting called 'Colibird review' tomorrow at 10:00 to my calendar.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the event details for confirmation, then creates the event in the demo calendar and returns its title, date and time.

positive.description: Draft a reply to an email without sending it
positive.prompt: Find the latest email in my inbox and draft a short reply thanking the sender. Don't send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the latest demo email and saves a reply as a draft in the mail app. Nothing is sent; it says the draft is ready to review.

positive.prompt: Find the PDF invoices in my Documents folder and put the vendor, date and total of each one in a new Excel file.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the sample invoice PDFs on the demo computer, extracts vendor, date and total, and creates an Excel file with one row per invoice, returning its path.

positive.prompt: Remind me tomorrow at 9am to send the quote to the customer.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a reminder for tomorrow at 9:00 on the demo computer and confirms its title and due time.

negative.description: General knowledge question with no personal data
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
Pay my electricity bill with my credit card.

negative.description: Accounts or computers the user has not connected
negative.prompt: Read my coworker's email from their laptop.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Renamed to Colibird (the directory asks that the plugin name not contain «MCP»). Same tools, skills and hosted server as 1.2.4.
